extractionMethod: Direct source-region crops rendered from the official PDF at probed high scales, using useful-content bounds measured on the prior x5 page-sheet asset plus safety padding. The helper renders the crop-sized PDF region instead of a huge full page, records successful/skipped scales and useful-glyph scale ratios, and never translates, redraws, recolors, cleans, retouches, masks, inpaints, or reconstructs protected pixels.
nonWhiteRule: alpha > 0 and any RGB channel below threshold; refined from the initial all-channel wording so saturated sign colors are not missed

skippedRenderScales.reason: Not committed because the official PDF embeds this visual at source-limited raster detail; x5 direct region render already matches the usable native detail and avoids creating a browser-upscaled-looking asset.

targets.selectedRenderScaleReason: Scale 5.0 was the highest successful committed crop-region render in this run; larger configured probe scales are recorded as skipped with resource evidence.

skippedRenderScales.reason: Not committed because the official PDF embeds this visual at source-limited raster detail; x5 direct region render already matches the usable native detail and avoids creating a browser-upscaled-looking asset.

targets.sourceQualityDisposition: source-limited-native-raster-in-official-pdf; committed x5 direct PDF region crop preserves the official blind-spot visual as-is, trims only surrounding page whitespace and the unrelated printed page number, and caps runtime display at the natural 546px width instead of browser-upscaling
